subject.title: feat(sandbox): route plugin-tool untrusted fetch+extract through Docker sandbox

question: Should OpenClaw expose `fetchAndExtractSandboxed` and `sandboxExecKey` as stable plugin SDK surface, or keep this capability behind a narrower owner-specific/internal seam until the plugin sandbox contract is designed?
rationale: The change is additive but establishes an external SDK contract and a cross-boundary sandbox capability; code review alone cannot choose the repository’s long-term plugin API direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Accept this as the supported generic plugin primitive, with explicit upgrade documentation and real Docker evidence before merge.

options.title: Keep it owner-specific for now
options.body: Remove the public SDK subpath and context field, and implement the behavior in the owning plugin until a general plugin sandbox API is intentionally designed.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept this as the supported generic plugin primitive, with explicit upgrade documentation and real Docker evidence before merge.
